checks.name: Packaged extension loads and popup discovers the worker
Popup saves threshold and pauses automatic unloading
Popup layout has a bounded scroll area and no horizontal overflow
Site protection persists and can be removed without changing defaults
Trusted edits, actual media and embedded frames are reported by the content script
Service worker shutdown preserves pause, preferences and tab protection
Only genuine popup senders may mutate worker state
Real alarm unloads an idle safe page without closing or unloading protected fixtures
An active real download vetoes an otherwise idle eligible tab across an alarm
Restore control selects the same tab, reloads it and learns a longer host delay

evidence.note: One automation-observed reload; not a median benchmark.

checks.name: Edit reset confirmation clears only edits and new trusted edits protect again
History export produces a completed metadata-only JSON download
Cancel and confirmed history/learning/full resets honor their documented scopes
Manual close skips a restored selection and closes only a still-discarded selected tab
Browser settings pages disable current-page controls
Browser restart retains local settings but grants new unpaused session grace

limitations: Headless Chrome: native permission prompts and OS save-picker interaction require a headed check.
The download behavior is directed to the disposable output directory, bypassing the OS save picker.
Acceptance timing is not a paired resource-savings benchmark.
